name: Input Buffer
description: Predictive input buffering for Geometry Dash. Simplified version with numbers.

stage.name: Main Buffer Window (Ticks)
stage.description:
Default window for every mode set to -1 below.

**0** = Off
**1-16** = Window size in ticks.
